Name: (CP)(FF) Ignifex's Static and Animated NPC Furniture
Author: Ignifex
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/R8Fvg13.gif[/img][/center][center]



Ever imagined villagers in certain settings? Or how would they look in your farm or farmhouse? Well, now you can invite them! ...sort of.

This is a collection of almost all vanilla NPCs as furniture, featuring their various poses and actions! 

Have them sit down and read in your home library, bask in the sun on your beach farm, garden in your greenhouse, or whatever your imagination can think of! Let those creative ideas come to life![/center]




[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/yEaBh7Z.png[/img][/center]


To install, download this mod and extract it to the Mods folder. For custom sprites, put them in the assets folder of the CP compatibility mod. Ensure that you follow the vanilla naming conventions and sprite positions. 

To uninstall, remove all the furniture from your save, and then delete this mod from your Mods folder.





[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ldraSM9.png[/img][/center]﻿


[size=5][b][center]CP Retexture Config:[/center][/b][/size]
There are two configurations available for CP custom sprites. Please note that you have to add custom sprites to the CP mod assets folder in order for the config to work! The asset folder is ALWAYS empty when you download this mod.

[b][size=3]Custom Sprites[/size][/b]: Retextures the FF furniture to the custom sprites you added to the assets folder

[size=3][b]Seasonal:
[/b][/size]
[b]ON: [/b]
- If you have custom sprites but they aren't seasonal, turning on this config will only use the single custom sprite of a character for all seasons.
- If you have custom seasonal sprites, turning on this config will let the FF furniture change with the seasons. This comes with an additional winter indoor and outdoor checking, if they're available.

[b]OFF:[/b]
- If you have custom seasonal sprites, turning off this config will default the sprites to the Spring variation for all seasons.



[b][size=5][center]FF Furniture Config:[/center][/size][/b]
If you have custom seasonal sprites in CP and don't want the separate Winter furniture, simply open the config file for the FF furniture in a text editor and use the Find and Replace feature, and then replace "[b][u]winter": true[/u][/b]" with "[u][u][b]winter": false[/b][/u][/u]".





[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/i1tagXC.png[/img][/center]﻿

This mod is compatible with the following:

[list=1]
[*]Content Patcher version 2.8.1
[*]Furniture Framework version 3.2.4
[*]All custom sprites that adhere to vanilla's naming conventions and sprite positions.
[/list]




[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ovmBOhK.png[/img][/center]


These are the things I'm planning on implementing in future updates (in no particular order):

[list]
[*]Config in CP to disable separate winter furniture so you don't have to change the FF config file manually
[*]Separate Festival sprites furniture
[*]Static versions of some animated furniture
[*]Completing all vanilla NPC (if there's demand)
[/list]
